lead: A `foreach` binding with no type is a syntax error, not an untyped binding
body: : `rule:types/grammar`.2 makes every binding write its type, so `foreach ($xs as $v)` reports `E0101` at the name and a case asking what a bare binding carries never gets that far. A handoff item can name the construct in that PHP shape anyway, because nothing in an LSP file set contradicts it. Run `nvs check` over the `--FILE--` document before freezing anything about it.
